executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 45 errors due to missing Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 dependencies. This is similar to attempt 1 but with 2 additional errors in UserTaskController. The build cannot proceed because critical framework packages are not available. Add the missing dependencies to pom.xml to resolve all compilation errors.

errors.message: Spring Security packages do not exist (web.builders, web.configuration, config.http, security.web)
errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. The SecurityConfig class requires Spring Security framework classes that are not available.

errors.message: Spring Data Domain packages do not exist (Pageable, Page)
errors.root_cause: Spring Data JPA dependency is missing. TaskManagementController requires Pageable and Page classes for pagination support.

errors.message: Jakarta Persistence package does not exist
errors.root_cause: Jakarta Persistence API is missing. Entity classes require @Entity, @Table, @Id, @Column, and other JPA annotations from jakarta.persistence package.
errors.fix_recommendation: Jakarta Persistence is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa. Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa dependency is added to pom.xml.

errors.message: Apache Commons Lang3 package does not exist
errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 dependency is missing from pom.xml. ValidationUtils requires StringUtils or other utility classes from this library.
